note: Otter Tail County has a planning and zoning office for unincorporated land, but no county zoning-district layer is in its ArcGIS services (web2 and services3 directories, open data hub) or in its web apps. Fergus Falls and Detroit Lakes publish zoning maps only through a city server and an Integrity GIS viewer, neither reachable from here, and no queryable zoning service was found.
